description:
Cutover registered all 113 canonical JoinOrder SQL query IDs in the
DataFrame registry, but only the original 13 had expression-family and
pandas-family translations. The remaining 100 raised NotImplementedError
and pointed here.

Completed by preserving the original 13 hand-written translations and adding
a restricted canonical JOB SQL-to-DataFrame translator for the remaining
canonical query shape: comma-join tables, WHERE predicates, equality joins,
and top-level MIN(...) projections. The generated pandas-family and
expression-family paths are validated against DuckDB on the canonical tiny
fixture for all 100 formerly untranslated query IDs.

preserves.behavior: Generated translations stay restricted to the canonical JOB query shape.
Original 13 hand-written JoinOrder DataFrame translations remain available.
SQL-mode JoinOrder query text and execution path remain unchanged.

verifications.description: JoinOrder DataFrame query module lint passes

work_units.notes:
Added generated expression-family and pandas-family implementations for
the 100 query IDs that previously raised NotImplementedError. The
original 13 hand-written translations remain in place.
work_units.summary: Translate remaining canonical JoinOrder query IDs for DataFrame mode

work_units.notes:
`tests/unit/core/joinorder/test_dataframe_query_capabilities.py` now
compares every generated pandas-family and Polars expression-family query
against the canonical DuckDB SQL result on
`tests/fixtures/joinorder_canonical_tiny`.
work_units.summary: Validate generated DataFrame translations against DuckDB

work_units.notes:
`get_untranslated_dataframe_query_ids()` now returns an empty list, so
default DataFrame selection includes all 113 canonical query IDs.
work_units.summary: Remove DataFrame skip policy for canonical JoinOrder
